entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA1303, CA1508, CA5390 and CA5403 are quadratic in the number of call sites into a method: 1.0s without the rule, 66.8s with it #56280

Closed

  • [AI discovered CI] dotnet-new IntegrationTests hangs on macOS arm64 during CanDisplayDetails_InstalledPackage_LocalPackage #56229
  • SourceFileUpdateTests.RenameSourceFile: flaky failure — FileNotFoundException on Foo.cs / missing '> Renamed.cs' output #55137

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/11.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56279
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56278

Merged

  • Serialize dotnet-new details tests to prevent Helix hangs #56230

Updated

  • Send process id from the agent to the client in initial response. #56245
    Area-Watch
  • Update `.editorconfig` template to set `dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups` to `false` #50476
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Common templates
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Backport MTP diagnostics and --nologo support #55939
    Servicing-consider
  • Honor MTP zero-tests and exit-code policies in dotnet test #56219
  • Optimize top-level command help parsing #56267
  • Fix outdated VS version reference in .gitignore template #52267
    Area-Infrastructure, stale
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #56192
